title: 5 Days & 4 Nights Yoga Retreat in Uluwatu Bali
metaTitle: 5 Days Yoga Retreat In Uluwatu Bali
metaDescription: Join the 5-Day Yoga Retreat in Ubud, Bali with Bali Yoga School — the island’s top yoga center. Stay in serene private rooms, enjoy daily yoga, healing sessions, Balinese massage, and meditation surrounded by lush gardens and pools. Refresh your body, mind, and soul naturally.
summary: A 5 days & 4 nights yoga retreat in Uluwatu with daily pranayama & meditation, Hatha Vinyasa yoga, healing sessions and 4 complimentary Balinese massages.
intro: You will be having daily yoga classes as well as daily healing classes and Balinese massage treatment in our spa. Yoga instructors at Bali Yoga School teach authentic and personalised yoga lessons according to your condition and experience. The 5 day yoga retreat in Bali enables you to integrate the benefits of authentic yoga practices with our professional sound and reiki healers.
Our teachers possess the ancient knowledge and modern yoga teaching methods to offer classes for beginner, intermediate and advanced levels for yoga practitioners.
durationStatements: 5 DAYS & 4 NIGHTS YOGA RETREAT IN ULUWATU BALI

dining.text: We serve plant-based meals, prepared with the highest standards of hygiene, cleanliness, and love to support your yoga journey. Lunch & Dinner are not served on Sundays.

arrival: Check In – On the Day 1st after 12:00 pm
Check Out – On the last day before 12:00 pm

The best and most convenient way to travel to Bali Yoga School is to take a flight to Denpasar Bali airport. Denpasar Bali airport is merely 38 km away from our school. As soon as you book your flight, forward us your flight details and we will send our driver to meet you from Denpasar Bali airport and drive to the school. (Pick-up service is with a little extra cost)
prerequisites: Classes offered for beginner, intermediate and advanced levels.

policies.title: Class timings
items: The Management team holds the right to change the timings of the classes if it is needed.

policies.title: Booking Process
items: In order to book for retreat kindly deposit the Advance booking amount of 150 USD. Balance should be paid on arrival either by card, cash or Online transfer. An official confirmation letter concerning your program will be sent to you shortly after successful advance booking fee.

policies.title: Refund Policy
items: Advance Booking deposit is non refundable, we accept date rescheduling. If you cancel the course after joining, we accept the cancellation but the course fees will not be refunded with the cancellation.
